# Research results: do ingredients predict product success?

*Generated by `scripts/run_research.py` on 2026-10-25. Do not edit by hand — re-run the script. Method and interpretation: [RESEARCH.md](RESEARCH.md).*

All findings are associations in this Sephora dataset. None is a causal, medical or safety claim.

- Catalogue products: 8,494
